title: Intermediate profile.yml (contract v1)
description: Identity and network profiles. Feeds _data/socials.yml (see ../SCHEMA-NOTES.md §2 for the 49 keys jekyll-socials accepts) and the About page. Every field is optional: the plugin emits only the properties present in the graph, and drops nulls because this file is a mapping.

id.description: The username or identifier — the label of the graph's markdown link, or the raw property when it was not a link.

url.description: Absent or null when the graph property was not a markdown link; the transform then builds the URL from the id via jekyll-socials' own template.

link.description: A network profile as {id, url}. Not every network here has a built-in jekyll-socials key — checked against the gem: `strava_userid` exists, while `wikiloc`, `goodreads` and `cienciavitae` have none in any spelling and need the arbitrary-key custom-social form (SCHEMA-NOTES.md §2). The transform raises on any key it has no mapping for (D41), so a network added here without a mapping fails the build rather than vanishing — which makes this file's side of the seam land *before* the plugin starts emitting a new key.
